title: Trying to figure out how to incorporate something into night combat...
author: No_Departure7494
selftext:
If I'm building a war game with planes, ships, helicopters, tanks, etc - I want to add in parachute flares that illuminate the map at night...

The thing is, I also don't want to remove any of these vehicles specialties like the rockets they're equipped with.

It needs to be player based (Not automated by some random aircraft flying over because that removes the strategy). 

How would you go about doing this? It's a highly specific question but the vehicles already have so many loadouts that I don't want to add / remove any more and I definitely do not want to add another vehicle.

comments.author: taisui
comments.body: What is the goal of the flares?
